senses.en: Waiting for a decision or for something to happen
Until something happens or while waiting for it

ex.en: Our application is still pending, so we cannot book flights.
ex.zh: 我们的申请仍在审批中，所以还不能订机票。

ex.en: Construction should remain suspended pending a thorough assessment of its potential impact on the surrounding environment.
ex.zh: 在全面评估施工对周边环境的潜在影响之前，工程应继续暂停。

col: a pending application｜待处理的申请
tip: 核心是尚未决定或完成，不要误当作urgent（紧迫的）。

senses.en: To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed.
A control unit for equipment, or a machine for video games.

ex.en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
ex.zh: 弟弟的球队输了比赛后，莉娜试着安慰他。

ex.en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.
ex.zh: 教师应安慰失落的学生，同时帮助他们制定切实可行的策略来提高学习成绩。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

senses.en: To end something, or to come to an end.
For a transport service, to reach its final stop.

ex.en: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
ex.zh: 我们上个月决定终止健身房会员资格。

ex.en: Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.
ex.zh: 雇主终止合同时，应提供明确理由，并给予员工充足的回应时间。

col: terminate at a station｜在某站终到
tip: 正式用词；可及物或不及物，列车终到用at。

senses.en: An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.
A small amount of bodily material taken for medical testing.

ex.en: The museum keeps this butterfly specimen behind glass.
ex.zh: 博物馆将这件蝴蝶标本保存在玻璃罩内。

ex.en: Researchers examined each plant specimen to assess how prolonged drought had affected its growth.
ex.zh: 研究人员检查了每份植物样本，以评估长期干旱对其生长的影响。

tip: specimen多指供研究或检验的样本，不泛指任何例子。

senses.en: Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.

ex.en: The ruthless landlord evicted the family without any warning.
ex.zh: 那个冷酷无情的房东毫无预警地赶走了这家人。

ex.en: Ruthless competition may encourage companies to cut labour costs at the expense of employee welfare.
ex.zh: 残酷的竞争可能促使企业以牺牲员工福利为代价来削减用工成本。

col: a ruthless leader｜冷酷无情的领导者
tip: 比strict更强，强调为达目的而不顾他人感受或利益。

senses.en: The system or process of collecting money through taxes.

ex.en: Taxation helps pay for our local schools and roads.
ex.zh: 税收为我们当地的学校和道路提供资金。

ex.en: Progressive taxation can reduce income inequality by requiring wealthier citizens to contribute a larger proportion of their earnings.
ex.zh: 累进税制要求较富裕的公民缴纳更高比例的收入，有助于缩小收入差距。

tip: taxation通常不可数，侧重征税制度或过程。

senses.en: to make something last longer

ex.en: Exercise may prolong your life.
ex.zh: 运动可能延长寿命。

ex.en: Salting and smoking fish prolonged its shelf life, allowing communities to store food for the winter.
ex.zh: 腌制和熏制延长了鱼的保存期，使人们能储存过冬的食物。

tip: prolonged 长期的。

senses.en: A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.

ex.en: We watched the wind turbine turning slowly above the fields.
ex.zh: 我们看着风力涡轮机在田野上方缓缓转动。

ex.en: Installing offshore wind turbines can increase renewable electricity generation, although potential impacts on marine ecosystems require careful assessment.
ex.zh: 安装海上风力涡轮机可以增加可再生能源发电量，不过其对海洋生态系统的潜在影响需要仔细评估。

tip: 重音在首音节；wind turbine指风力涡轮机。

senses.en: the amount by which spending exceeds income
a shortage of something needed

ex.en: Our club faces a deficit after buying new equipment.
ex.zh: 购买新设备后，我们俱乐部出现了资金缺口。

ex.en: Governments may reduce a budget deficit by raising taxes, but this can slow economic growth.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过增税减少预算赤字，但这可能减缓经济增长。

tip: 赤字用deficit；债务用debt，二者不同。

senses.en: the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad

ex.en: The importation of fresh fruit requires careful temperature control.
ex.zh: 进口新鲜水果需要严格控制温度。

ex.en: Restrictions on the importation of agricultural products may protect local farmers but increase food prices for consumers.
ex.zh: 限制农产品进口可能保护本地农民，却也会提高消费者购买食品的价格。

tip: 较正式，通常不可数；常用the importation of。

senses.en: What someone plans or means to do.
Giving all your attention to something.
Firmly determined to do or achieve something.

ex.en: My intent was to help, not to interrupt you.
ex.zh: 我本意是帮忙，而不是打断你。

ex.en: Many governments are intent on reducing traffic congestion through investment in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 许多政府决心通过投资可靠的公共交通来减少交通拥堵。

col: with the intent of｜怀着……的目的
intent on doing something｜决意做某事
a statement of intent｜意向声明
tip: intent on后接名词或动名词，表示专注或决意。

senses.en: The time when a young person's body develops into an adult's.

ex.en: Puberty brings rapid physical and emotional change.
ex.zh: 青春期带来迅速的身体和情绪变化。

senses.en: based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons
using power according to personal wishes rather than fair rules

ex.en: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
ex.zh: 她的选择显得很随意：她连看都没看就选了。

ex.en: Arbitrary restrictions on university admissions can prevent capable students from accessing education and may reinforce existing social inequalities.
ex.zh: 大学招生中缺乏合理依据的限制可能让有能力的学生无法入学，并加剧现有的社会不平等。

col: an arbitrary limit｜随意设定的限制
tip: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

senses.en: A musical performance given by one person or a small group.
A spoken account describing a series of facts or events.

ex.en: Her first piano recital drew a small but enthusiastic audience.
ex.zh: 她的首场钢琴独奏会吸引了人数不多却十分热情的观众。

ex.en: Regular opportunities to give a recital can help music students develop confidence and improve their performance skills.
ex.zh: 定期举办独奏会的机会可以帮助音乐专业学生建立信心并提高演奏技巧。

col: a recital of facts｜事实的逐一陈述
tip: 音乐语境多指独奏或独唱，不等于大型演唱会。

senses.en: to push or drive forward

ex.en: The boat is propelled by oars.
ex.zh: 这条船靠桨推进。

ex.en: Squid propel themselves through the water by forcing jets of water out of their bodies.
ex.zh: 乌贼通过从体内喷出水流在水中推进。

tip: propeller 螺旋桨。

senses.en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt
An uneven way of walking caused by an affected leg
Not firm or stiff; lacking strength or support

ex.en: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
ex.zh: 扭伤脚踝后，我只好一瘸一拐地走回家。

ex.en: Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.
ex.zh: 受伤后仍然跛行的运动员应先接受专业评估，再重返竞技运动。

col: walk with a limp｜一瘸一拐地走
tip: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。

senses.en: Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries.
The hot region between these circles, called the tropics.

ex.en: Our guide pointed to the northern tropic on a globe.
ex.zh: 导游指了指地球仪上的北回归线。

ex.en: Communities in the tropics often depend on seasonal rainfall to sustain agriculture and maintain reliable freshwater supplies.
ex.zh: 热带地区的社区往往依赖季节性降雨来维持农业生产和稳定的淡水供应。

tip: 回归线用单数；热带地区固定用the tropics。

senses.en: Make someone believe something that is not true.

ex.en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the work is finished.
ex.zh: 别自欺欺人地以为工作已经完成了。

ex.en: Policymakers should not delude themselves into believing that economic growth alone will eliminate poverty and social inequality.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应自欺欺人地认为，仅靠经济增长就能消除贫困和社会不平等。

col: delude someone into believing｜使某人误信
tip: 常用delude oneself into doing，指自欺欺人地做某事。

senses.en: To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements.
To fail to hold something or deal with something smoothly.

ex.en: I fumbled for my keys in the dark hallway.
ex.zh: 我在漆黑的走廊里摸索着找钥匙。

ex.en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.
ex.zh: 使用者操作不熟悉的控制装置时常常手忙脚乱，这凸显了公共交通系统中直观设计的重要性。

col: fumble for keys｜摸索着找钥匙
fumble with a lock｜笨手笨脚地摆弄锁
tip: fumble for表示摸索寻找；with表示笨拙摆弄。

senses.en: Extremely violent, fierce, or cruel.
Extremely harsh or severe.
To attack violently or criticize someone very harshly.

ex.en: The documentary showed a savage fight between two wolves.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片展现了两只狼之间的激烈搏斗。

ex.en: The proposed reduction in education funding attracted savage criticism from teachers and parents across the country.
ex.zh: 削减教育经费的提议遭到了全国教师和家长的严厉批评。

tip: 勿用作名词称呼族群，有贬损和冒犯意味。
note: 作名词指人，尤其指族群时，具有冒犯性。

senses.en: Extremely useful or valuable.

ex.en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
ex.zh: 我买第一辆自行车时，你的建议帮了大忙。

ex.en: Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.
ex.zh: 实际工作经验能帮助学生深入了解雇主对新毕业生技能的期望，这种了解十分宝贵。

col: an invaluable resource｜极有用的资源
tip: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

senses.en: to stop happening or doing something

ex.en: The bells finally ceased ringing just before midnight.
ex.zh: 临近午夜时，钟声终于停了。

ex.en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.
ex.zh: 工厂应停止向河流排放未经处理的废水，以保护水生生态系统和公众健康。

tip: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

senses.en: The way information is presented, which affects how people decide.

ex.en: Because of framing, '90% survive' sounds better than '10% die'.
ex.zh: 由于框架效应，“90%存活”听起来比“10%死亡”好。

senses.en: to be successful, especially financially

ex.en: The business prospered after the move.
ex.zh: 搬迁后生意兴隆。

ex.en: Towns along the river prospered as trade between the coast and the interior grew.
ex.zh: 随着沿海与内陆贸易增长，河畔城镇日益繁荣。

tip: 托福同义替换：prosper ≈ thrive ≈ flourish。

senses.en: to give someone pleasure or satisfaction
to satisfy a desire or need

ex.en: Your kind words will gratify everyone who helped today.
ex.zh: 你的暖心话会让今天所有帮忙的人感到欣慰。

ex.en: Policies that gratify immediate consumer desires may conflict with the need to protect resources for future generations.
ex.zh: 满足消费者眼前欲望的政策，可能与为后代保护资源的需要相冲突。

tip: 较正式；常用be gratified by表示因某事欣慰。

senses.en: Full of important, interesting, or unexpected events.

ex.en: After an eventful morning, we finally sat down for lunch.
ex.zh: 经历了状况不断的一上午后，我们终于坐下来吃午饭。

ex.en: An eventful period of political reform transformed the country's education system and expanded access to schooling.
ex.zh: 一段大事频发的政治改革时期改变了该国的教育体系，并扩大了入学机会。

col: an eventful day｜事情很多的一天
an eventful journey｜状况不断的旅程
an eventful life｜经历丰富的一生
tip: 指发生许多值得注意的事，不一定都是坏事。

senses.en: a large feather, especially one used for decoration
a rising mass of smoke, water, or dust

ex.en: A bright plume decorated the dancer's tall hat.
ex.zh: 舞者的高帽上装饰着一根鲜艳的大羽毛。

ex.en: A thick plume of smoke rose above the factory, raising concerns about local air quality.
ex.zh: 工厂上方升起一股浓烟，引发了人们对当地空气质量的担忧。

col: a plume of smoke｜一股浓烟
a plume of feathers｜一簇羽毛
a volcanic plume｜火山喷出的烟柱
tip: 既指大羽毛，也指形似羽毛的烟柱、水柱。

senses.en: feeling uncertain or doubtful about something
probably dishonest, unsafe, or not worth trusting

ex.en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
ex.zh: 对于买一辆没有刹车的自行车，我心存疑虑。

ex.en: Consumers should remain dubious about health claims that are not supported by reliable scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 消费者应对没有可靠科学证据支持的健康功效宣称保持怀疑。

tip: 人感到怀疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

senses.en: boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change

ex.en: A short walk broke the monotony of my afternoon.
ex.zh: 短暂的散步打破了我下午的单调乏味。

ex.en: Rotating tasks can reduce the monotony of factory work while helping employees develop a wider range of skills.
ex.zh: 轮换任务可以减少工厂工作的单调感，同时帮助员工培养更多样的技能。

col: the monotony of daily life｜日常生活的单调
tip: 通常为不可数名词，强调缺少变化带来的乏味。

senses.en: a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft

ex.en: The boat's propeller churned the water into white foam.
ex.zh: 船的螺旋桨把水搅成了白色泡沫。

ex.en: Engineers are developing quieter propeller designs to reduce the impact of shipping noise on marine wildlife.
ex.zh: 工程师正在开发更安静的螺旋桨设计，以减少航运噪声对海洋野生动物的影响。

tip: propel是推进；propeller是提供推力的螺旋桨。

senses.en: to send out heat, light or energy in all directions
to spread out from a central point

ex.en: The stove radiates warmth.
ex.zh: 炉子散发着暖意。

ex.en: At night, the ground radiates heat back into the sky, which is why clear nights are often colder.
ex.zh: 夜间地面向天空辐射热量，所以晴朗的夜晚往往更冷。

tip: 生物学 adaptive radiation 适应辐射。

senses.en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.

ex.en: This tractor has enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
ex.zh: 这辆拖拉机的马力足以拉动那辆沉重的拖车。

ex.en: Although greater horsepower can improve vehicle performance, fuel efficiency remains a major consideration for many consumers.
ex.zh: 虽然更大的马力可以提升车辆性能，但燃油效率仍是许多消费者的重要考量。

tip: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。

senses.en: A difference or disagreement between things.
A statistical measure of how widely values differ from their mean.

ex.en: His cheerful smile was at variance with his complaints.
ex.zh: 他愉快的笑容与他的抱怨很不相称。

ex.en: The proposed housing policy is at variance with the government's commitment to protecting green spaces.
ex.zh: 拟议的住房政策与政府保护绿地的承诺相矛盾。

tip: at variance with 表示不一致；统计学中指方差。

senses.en: A thought or interest that fills someone's mind all the time.

ex.en: His obsession with cleanliness made daily life difficult.
ex.zh: 他对洁净的强迫观念让日常生活变得困难。

senses.en: A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.

ex.en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by the local militia.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了当地民兵曾经穿过的制服。

ex.en: Historical records show that the militia consisted mainly of farmers who trained alongside their regular work.
ex.zh: 历史记录显示，这支民兵主要由农民组成，他们在日常劳作之余参加训练。

col: a local militia｜地方民兵组织
form a militia｜组建民兵组织
tip: 指组织；单个成员用a militia member。

senses.en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable
to give someone advice or professional support
a lawyer or lawyers representing someone in a legal case

ex.en: I sought my aunt's counsel before accepting the job.
ex.zh: 接受这份工作前，我征求了姑姑的意见。

ex.en: Schools should employ trained professionals to counsel students who experience anxiety about examinations or future careers.
ex.zh: 学校应聘用受过培训的专业人士，为因考试或未来职业而焦虑的学生提供咨询。

col: counsel someone against something｜劝某人不要做某事
tip: counsel指忠告或律师；council指委员会。

senses.en: a very large quantity of something

ex.en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
ex.zh: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。

ex.en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
ex.zh: 丰富的自然资源并不一定能保证可持续的经济增长或生活水平的提高。

col: an abundance of wildlife｜丰富的野生动物
tip: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

senses.en: A vertical passage through a building or into the ground.
A long narrow part of a tool or machine.
A narrow beam of light.

ex.en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
ex.zh: 电梯在狭窄井道的中途停了下来。

ex.en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.
ex.zh: 工程师安装了通风井，以改善整个地下交通站点的空气质量。

col: a shaft of sunlight｜一束阳光
tip: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft对应美式elevator shaft。

senses.en: in a way that suits the particular situation
as a result of something

ex.en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
ex.zh: 天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。

ex.en: Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.
ex.zh: 学校应识别每个学生的学习需求，并相应调整教学方法，以支持所有学生。

tip: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

senses.en: giving off energy from breaking atoms

ex.en: Radioactive waste must be stored safely.
ex.zh: 放射性废料必须安全存放。

ex.en: Radioactive elements decay at a steady rate, which allows scientists to calculate the age of rocks.
ex.zh: 放射性元素以稳定速率衰变，科学家借此计算岩石年龄。

tip: 定年法核心概念。

senses.en: A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed.
A district used for policing or elections.
The grounds surrounding a building, especially a religious building.

ex.en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
ex.zh: 我们在步行商业区的面包店外碰面。

ex.en: Creating a pedestrian precinct can encourage local shopping while reducing traffic pollution in city centres.
ex.zh: 设立步行商业区既能鼓励本地消费，又能减少市中心的交通污染。

tip: 指建筑物周围的区域时，通常用复数precincts。

senses.en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills
the purchase of a business, or something that has been obtained

ex.en: Daily conversations helped with her acquisition of new vocabulary.
ex.zh: 日常交谈帮助她掌握了新词汇。

ex.en: Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 尽早接触多样的语言表达能促进语言习得，增强儿童有效沟通的能力。

tip: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。

senses.en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe

ex.en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 厚窗帘帮助减轻了街上传来的噪声。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 在城市地区植树可以减轻酷热的影响，并改善居民的生活质量。

col: mitigate the effects of｜减轻……的影响
mitigate climate change｜缓解气候变化
mitigating circumstances｜可减轻处罚的情节
tip: 正式用词，直接接风险、损害或影响，不表示彻底消除。

senses.en: The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments.
The state of being fully grown or developed.
The time when an investment or debt becomes repayable.

ex.en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
ex.zh: 莉娜冷静地承认自己的错误，表现得很成熟。

ex.en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生尊重他人地解决分歧并考虑不同观点，从而促进其情绪成熟。

tip: 通常不可数；金融语境中at maturity表示到期时。

senses.en: A tendency to expect bad things to happen.

ex.en: Pessimism may make people less likely to try again.
ex.zh: 悲观可能使人不太愿意再试一次。

senses.en: put something safely away, especially for a journey

ex.en: Please stow your bag under the seat in front.
ex.zh: 请把包放好，置于前方座位下。

ex.en: Passengers must stow their luggage securely so that loose items do not cause injuries during unexpected turbulence.
ex.zh: 乘客必须妥善放好行李，以免松散物品在突发颠簸中造成人员受伤。

tip: stow away可指收好；人作主语时也可指藏匿偷乘。

senses.en: training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation
forming general conclusions from particular observations
production of electrical effects by a changing magnetic field

ex.en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
ex.zh: 我们的入职培训包括参观整个办公室。

ex.en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.
ex.zh: 系统的入职培训可以帮助新员工了解工作要求并适应岗位。

tip: 入职常用induction；归纳与deduction演绎相对。

senses.en: to move back or become smaller

ex.en: The floodwaters began to recede.
ex.zh: 洪水开始退去。

ex.en: As the glaciers receded at the end of the ice age, they left behind lakes and piles of rock.
ex.zh: 冰期末冰川退缩，留下了湖泊和石堆。

tip: 托福同义替换：recede ≈ retreat。

senses.en: A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.

ex.en: The band's vocalist sang softly while the guitarist played.
ex.zh: 吉他手弹奏时，乐队的歌手轻声演唱。

ex.en: A skilled vocalist can help traditional music reach younger audiences without losing its distinctive cultural character.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的歌手能让传统音乐吸引年轻听众，同时保留其独特的文化特色。

tip: 常指乐队中的歌手；lead vocalist意为主唱。

senses.en: Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities.
Not firm, tight, or tense.

ex.en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
ex.zh: 这家俱乐部对会员卡的检查很松懈。

ex.en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 环境法规执行不严，使一些工厂得以向附近河流排放未经处理的废物。

col: lax about rules｜对规则要求不严
tip: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

senses.en: Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way
Lying flat with the face pointing downwards

ex.en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我的皮肤在寒冷天气里容易干燥。

ex.en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端风暴日益频繁，沿海居民区越来越容易遭受洪灾。

tip: prone to后接名词或动名词，通常指不好的情况。

senses.en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.

ex.en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
ex.zh: 我慢慢让自己习惯了开窗睡觉。

ex.en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
ex.zh: 学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。

col: accustom yourself to｜使自己习惯于
tip: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: something that exists independently, especially an organization

ex.en: Our small bakery now operates as a separate entity.
ex.zh: 我们的小面包店现在作为独立实体运营。

ex.en: Each university should remain an independent entity while cooperating with other institutions on important research projects.
ex.zh: 各大学在与其他机构合作开展重要研究项目的同时，应保持独立。

tip: 强调独立存在的单位，常用于机构、法律或商业语境。

senses.en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense

ex.en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
ex.zh: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。

ex.en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
ex.zh: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。

tip: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

senses.en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it.
The study of when past events happened.

ex.en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
ex.zh: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。

ex.en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
ex.zh: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。

col: establish a chronology｜确定时间顺序
a chronology of events｜事件年表
an accurate chronology｜准确的时间序列
tip: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

senses.en: Unpleasant effects when someone stops taking an addictive drug; also pulling back.

ex.en: Headaches are a common symptom of caffeine withdrawal.
ex.zh: 头痛是咖啡因戒断的常见症状。

senses.en: to build again or recreate from evidence

ex.en: The town was reconstructed after the war.
ex.zh: 小镇在战后重建了。

ex.en: Using fossil pollen, scientists can reconstruct the vegetation that covered the region during the last ice age.
ex.zh: 利用化石花粉，科学家能复原末次冰期时覆盖该地区的植被。

tip: 考古与古气候讲座常见。

senses.en: Spending more money than is necessary or sensible.
Something expensive bought or done for pleasure rather than necessity.

ex.en: Buying fresh flowers every week is my only extravagance.
ex.zh: 每周买鲜花是我唯一的奢侈享受。

ex.en: Public criticism of government extravagance often increases when essential services face severe budget cuts.
ex.zh: 当基本公共服务面临大幅预算削减时，公众对政府铺张浪费的批评往往会增加。

col: an unnecessary extravagance｜不必要的奢侈之举
a taste for extravagance｜对奢华的偏爱
tip: 指挥霍行为通常不可数；指某项奢侈享受时可数。

senses.en: The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place.
The process of forcing something out of a space or body.

ex.en: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from the club.
ex.zh: 反复作弊导致他被俱乐部开除。

ex.en: Schools should consider supportive interventions before expulsion, as exclusion can seriously damage a young person's educational prospects.
ex.zh: 学校在开除学生之前应考虑采取支持性干预措施，因为排斥可能严重损害年轻人的教育前景。

tip: 常用expulsion from；对应动词为expel。

senses.en: The usual or expected standard of quality or performance.
The stated value of a share or bond.
The expected strokes needed for a golf hole or course.

ex.en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
ex.zh: 我感觉状态不佳，所以今晚会待在家里。

ex.en: Investment in teacher training could bring educational outcomes in disadvantaged areas up to par with wealthier districts.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训可使弱势地区的教育成效达到较富裕地区的水平。

col: on a par with｜与……不相上下
tip: on a par with表示不相上下；below par指状态欠佳。

senses.en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.

ex.en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
ex.zh: 无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。

ex.en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
ex.zh: 所有儿童都应能获得优质教育，无论其家庭收入或社会背景如何。

col: irrespective of the outcome｜不论结果如何
tip: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

senses.en: to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions

ex.en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
ex.zh: 在这家图书馆，逾期归还可能产生额外费用。

ex.en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.
ex.zh: 企业更换过时设备时可能产生大量费用，但现代技术能逐步提高生产效率。

tip: 过去式 incurred，现在分词 incurring，均双写 r。

senses.en: To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts.
To examine material carefully to find what is useful.

ex.en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉筛过后再加入碗中。

ex.en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须仔细筛查大量证据，才能对失业原因得出可靠的结论。

col: sift through evidence｜仔细审查证据
tip: sift through表示仔细查看，寻找有用信息。

senses.en: to copy exactly or repeat

ex.en: The team could not replicate the results.
ex.zh: 团队无法重现这些结果。

ex.en: Other laboratories must be able to replicate an experiment before its findings are widely accepted.
ex.zh: 一项实验必须能被其他实验室重复，其结论才会被广泛接受。

tip: 科学方法话题核心词。

senses.en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.
To move slowly and awkwardly because of weight or size.

ex.en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
ex.zh: 我们买了些木料，准备做一张花园长椅。

ex.en: Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.
ex.zh: 对可持续来源木材的需求可以促使林场主采取更负责任的管理方式。

col: a stack of lumber｜一堆木料
tip: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

senses.en: A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water

ex.en: Small fish sheltered among the roots of a mangrove.
ex.zh: 小鱼躲在一棵红树的根部之间。

ex.en: Mangrove forests protect coastal communities from storms while providing essential habitats for numerous marine species.
ex.zh: 红树林既能保护沿海社区免受风暴侵袭，也为众多海洋物种提供重要栖息地。

tip: 可指一棵红树；红树林常说mangrove forest。

senses.en: Seeing your own feelings in others; also an estimate of the future.

ex.en: Accusing others of anger can be a form of projection.
ex.zh: 指责别人生气可能是一种投射。

senses.en: Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream.
A small amount of liquid released in a narrow stream.

ex.en: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 她往烤鱼上挤了些柠檬汁。

ex.en: Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.
ex.zh: 节水灌溉系统将少量水直接喷向根部，减少干旱地区的水资源浪费。

col: squirt juice over something｜往某物上挤果汁
a squirt of sauce｜挤出的一点酱汁
tip: 常用squirt液体onto/into某处，强调细流喷出。

senses.en: needing someone or something for support or success

ex.en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
ex.zh: 没有汽车，我们只能依靠当地公交车。

ex.en: Countries heavily reliant on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
ex.zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

tip: 固定搭配reliant on；“自立的”是self-reliant。

senses.en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.
A lack of attention or respect for something.

ex.en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
ex.zh: 请忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍会照常举行。

ex.en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 无视环保法规的企业可能降低短期成本，却会对当地生态系统造成持久损害。

col: complete disregard for｜对……的完全漠视
disregard for safety｜对安全的漠视
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用disregard for。

senses.en: Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject.
Spoken or written language studied in its social context.

ex.en: Her lecture encouraged thoughtful discourse about local history.
ex.zh: 她的讲座引发了对当地历史的深入讨论。

ex.en: Public discourse on climate change increasingly focuses on practical solutions rather than distant predictions.
ex.zh: 关于气候变化的公共讨论越来越关注实际解决方案，而非遥远的预测。

tip: 语体正式；语言学中指话语或语篇，不等于论文。

senses.en: to be directly next to or share a boundary with something

ex.en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park with tall oak trees.
ex.zh: 我们的花园紧挨着一座长着高大橡树的安静公园。

ex.en: Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.
ex.zh: 与工业区相邻的住宅区可能需要额外措施，以保护居民免受噪声和污染影响。

tip: adjoin后直接接地点，不加to；强调直接相邻。

senses.en: a lake used to store water
a large supply of something

ex.en: The city gets water from a reservoir.
ex.zh: 城市从水库取水。

ex.en: Oceans act as a huge reservoir of heat, releasing it slowly and moderating coastal climates.
ex.zh: 海洋是巨大的热量储库，缓慢释放热量，调节沿海气候。

tip: 法语借词，结尾读 /-vwɑː/。

senses.en: The highest level of success, achievement or development.
A tall pointed rock or pointed structure on a building.

ex.en: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
ex.zh: 赢得那场锦标赛是她职业生涯的巅峰。

ex.en: For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.
ex.zh: 对许多研究人员而言，获得国际认可代表着献身科学探索的职业生涯达到顶峰。

col: the pinnacle of success｜成功的巅峰
tip: 比喻义常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的顶峰。

senses.en: To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear.
To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.

ex.en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
ex.zh: 阳光温暖了山谷，晨雾开始消散。

ex.en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.
ex.zh: 城市绿地有助于散热，减轻人口密集地区高温带来的不适。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：雾自行消散或风使雾消散。

senses.en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger

ex.en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
ex.zh: 突如其来的暴风雨使小船陷入险境。

ex.en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升威胁到住宅和关键基础设施，沿海社区面临的危险日益加剧。

col: put someone in peril｜使某人陷入险境
tip: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身处险境。

senses.en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.
A particular style or set of ideas about beauty.

ex.en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 这些木架让这个房间更有美感。

ex.en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。

tip: aesthetic指审美的；aesthetics常指美学。

senses.en: Choosing carefully or affecting only some things.

ex.en: Selective attention lets us focus on one voice in a noisy room.
ex.zh: 选择性注意让我们在嘈杂的房间里专注于一个声音。

senses.en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity
A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States

ex.en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
ex.zh: 比赛开始时，我们听到了一声哨响。

ex.en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 施工开始前应完成环境评估，以尽量减少对当地生态系统的潜在破坏。

col: the commencement of work｜工作的开始
tip: 表示“开始”较正式；美式英语中也指毕业典礼。

senses.en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.

ex.en: The small restaurant serves first-rate food at reasonable prices.
ex.zh: 这家小餐馆的菜品一流，价格也合理。

ex.en: Access to first-rate training enables young workers to develop skills that employers increasingly value.
ex.zh: 获得一流培训的机会能让年轻劳动者培养雇主日益看重的技能。

tip: first-rate表示质量一流，不是“第一次评价”。

senses.en: a sticky substance produced by some trees

ex.en: Pine trees produce sticky resin.
ex.zh: 松树会分泌黏稠的树脂。

ex.en: Insects trapped in tree resin millions of years ago have been preserved perfectly in amber.
ex.zh: 数百万年前被困在树脂中的昆虫在琥珀里保存得完好无损。

tip: 琥珀 amber 是树脂化石。

senses.en: At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs.
An adult female deer, especially a red deer.

ex.en: The rabbit pushed off with its powerful hind legs.
ex.zh: 兔子用有力的后腿一蹬，跳了出去。

ex.en: Kangaroos rely on their strong hind legs to travel efficiently across large areas in search of food.
ex.zh: 袋鼠依靠强壮的后腿高效穿越广阔区域，寻找食物。

tip: 作形容词主要修饰动物后肢，不泛指后面的事物。

senses.en: best suited to achieving a particular result
the most favourable level or condition for a particular purpose

ex.en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
ex.zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我种的香草提供了最适宜的条件。

ex.en: Maintaining the optimum classroom temperature can help students concentrate and reduce the energy required for heating.
ex.zh: 保持最适宜的教室温度有助于学生集中注意力，并减少供暖能耗。

tip: 强调最适合目标，并非越多越好；通常不用most修饰。

senses.zh: 心情矛盾的；态度摇摆的
senses.en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
ex.zh: 对于搬离家人这件事，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
ex.zh: 许多消费者对网购仍持矛盾态度，因为便利与隐私方面的担忧需要权衡。

tip: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

senses.en: The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity.
A strong desire to win or outperform others.

ex.en: Fresh ingredients help our bakery maintain its competitiveness locally.
ex.zh: 新鲜食材帮助我们这家面包店保持本地竞争力。

ex.en: Investment in workforce training can improve national competitiveness by increasing productivity and encouraging innovation across industries.
ex.zh: 投资员工培训可以提高生产率并促进各行业创新，从而增强国家竞争力。

tip: 不可数；既可指市场竞争力，也可指个人好胜心。

senses.en: Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts

ex.en: The box was crushed, but the cups remained intact.
ex.zh: 盒子被压坏了，但杯子依然完好无损。

ex.en: Careful restoration allows historic buildings to remain intact while meeting the safety requirements of modern urban life.
ex.zh: 精心修复可以使历史建筑保持完整，同时满足现代城市生活的安全要求。

tip: 常用于remain或leave之后，强调完整且未受损。

senses.en: easily affected or harmed by something

ex.en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
ex.zh: 这些幼苗特别容易遭受霜冻损害。

ex.en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
ex.zh: 儿童可能更容易受到网络广告影响，因为他们缺乏评估商业宣传的经验。

tip: 常用susceptible to，to后接名词。

senses.en: To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something.
A sudden change of direction by a vehicle or person.

ex.en: The cyclist swerved to avoid a branch on the road.
ex.zh: 骑车人突然转向，避开了路上的树枝。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads may force drivers to swerve unexpectedly, increasing the risk of collisions with other vehicles.
ex.zh: 养护不善的道路可能迫使司机突然转向，增加与其他车辆相撞的风险。

col: swerve to avoid something｜突然转向避开某物
swerve off the road｜突然偏离道路
tip: 强调突然改变方向；普通转弯通常用turn。

senses.en: money received by a business or government

ex.en: The company's revenue grew by ten percent.
ex.zh: 公司收入增长了百分之十。

ex.en: Taxes on trade provided most of the kingdom's revenue, so rulers protected the roads used by merchants.
ex.zh: 贸易税是王国的主要收入，所以统治者保护商人使用的道路。

tip: 经济话题核心词。

senses.en: Pleasant thoughts that take your attention away from what you are doing.

ex.en: He was lost in a daydream and missed the question.
ex.zh: 他陷入白日梦，没听到问题。

senses.en: Smaller in amount, degree, or importance

ex.en: We chose the lesser expense of repairing our sofa.
ex.zh: 我们选择了费用较低的方案，把沙发修好。

ex.en: Although funding matters, class size also influences educational outcomes, but usually to a lesser degree.
ex.zh: 虽然资金很重要，但班级规模也会影响教育成效，只是影响程度通常较小。

col: to a lesser extent｜在较小程度上
the lesser of two evils｜两害相权取其轻
tip: 通常放在名词前；不用于直接表示物体尺寸更小。

senses.en: To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.

ex.en: I erred by leaving the cake in too long.
ex.zh: 我把蛋糕烤得太久，失误了。

ex.en: Policymakers may err when they assume that economic growth automatically improves everyone's quality of life.
ex.zh: 政策制定者若认为经济增长会自动改善所有人的生活质量，可能会判断失误。

col: err on the side of caution｜宁可谨慎一些
tip: 较正式的不及物动词；常用err on the side of caution。

senses.en: Lower in rank, authority, or importance.
Someone with a lower position under another person's authority.

ex.en: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
ex.zh: 她接受了在这个项目中担任辅助角色。

ex.en: In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.
ex.zh: 在运作良好的组织中，下级员工应能放心地向高级管理人员提出疑虑。

tip: 表示“从属于”用subordinate to，不用than。

senses.en: Deeply and sincerely felt.

ex.en: She gave her neighbour a heartfelt hug before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前，她真挚地拥抱了邻居。

ex.en: A heartfelt apology can help restore public trust, but institutions must also demonstrate a genuine commitment to change.
ex.zh: 真诚的道歉有助于恢复公众信任，但机构还必须展现真正致力于改变的决心。

tip: 常修饰thanks、apology、sympathy，强调发自内心。

senses.en: To force someone out of a position or place.

ex.en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
ex.zh: 俱乐部成员投票罢免了不受欢迎的主席。

ex.en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.
ex.zh: 股东可能寻求罢免那些屡次未能履行环保承诺或实现财务目标的公司董事。

col: oust someone from office｜将某人赶下台
be ousted as chair｜被罢免主席职务
tip: 常用oust someone from office，强调被迫离职。

senses.en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation
an expert estimate of how much something is worth

ex.en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
ex.zh: 经理在今天的绩效评估中表扬了我的进步。

ex.en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
ex.zh: 任何大型建设项目启动之前，都应对环境风险进行全面评估。

tip: appraisal是评估；别与approval（批准）混淆。

senses.en: to move in a circle around a central point
to have as the main subject

ex.en: The earth revolves around the sun.
ex.zh: 地球绕着太阳转。

ex.en: Life in the village revolved around the annual flooding of the river.
ex.zh: 村庄的生活围绕着河流每年的泛滥展开。

tip: revolve 公转；rotate 自转。

senses.en: Able to work or exist together without problems
Having personalities or interests that allow a good relationship

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.zh: 这个充电器兼容我们的两台平板电脑。

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励更清洁的生产方式和负责任的资源利用，经济增长就能与环境保护并行。

tip: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

senses.en: Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks.
Continuing over a period without stopping.

ex.en: The continual interruptions made it hard to finish cooking.
ex.zh: 接二连三的打扰让人很难把饭做好。

ex.en: Continual changes in education policy can prevent teachers from developing effective long-term approaches to classroom learning.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变动可能妨碍教师制定有效的长期课堂教学方法。

tip: continual常指反复发生；continuous强调不中断。

senses.en: A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere.
The goods a business keeps available for sale.
To make a detailed list of items.

ex.en: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
ex.zh: 我们把车库里的所有东西列成了清单。

ex.en: Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.
ex.zh: 数字系统帮助零售商更高效地管理库存，减少浪费并防止必需品短缺。

tip: 表示库存时多见于美式英语，英式常用stock。
